newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai Merchant ups '97 sales forecast.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Merchant ups '97 sales forecast.

text.p: South Korea's Hyundai Merchant Marine Co Ltd, an affiliate of Hyundai Group, has raised its sales forecast for this year to 2.7 trillion won from 2.61 trillion, a company spokesman said on Thursday.
Hyundai Merchant, the largest Korean shipping company in terms of capacity and revenue, posted a 2.14 trillion won turnover last year.
"A recovery in the shipping industry and a rise in freight rates are expected to be behind the strong sales growth," the spokesman said by telephone.
Hyundai's fleet expansion by 16 carriers last year and cheaper fuel costs this year are also helping the liner's sales, he said.
The spokesman did not give Hyundai's profits forecast.

ING-Baring Securities said it expected Hyundai to post 28.2 billion won in net profit on a turnover of 2.6 trillion this year, while Dongbang Peregrine Securities saw Hyundai's earnings rising to 34.5 billion won on 2.7 trillion in sales.
Hyundai posted a 19.5 billion net profit last year.
